enonicRedCrossModule.title: Enonic 'Red Cross'
enonicRedCrossModule.subtitle: Project knowledge & testing assistant for the Norwegian Red Cross Enonic XP installation

overview.heroTitle: A grounded copilot for the Red Cross Enonic install
overview.heroSub: It explains the Enonic XP 8 / Content Studio 6 platform and answers project-specific questions about the Norwegian Red Cross installation and how to test it — citing sources and clearly separating platform documentation, confirmed project facts, dated observations, test recipes and plain suggestions.
overview.point1: Explains the Enonic platform with version-aware documentation links.
overview.point2: Answers project questions grounded only in a curated, source-credited knowledge base.
overview.point3: Searches the seeded Sprint-7 test cases by id, title, persona and result.
overview.point4: Drafts proposed manual test procedures — clearly labelled, with local draft ids, never invented Azure DevOps ids.
overview.evidenceTitle: Every claim is tagged by evidence level
overview.evidenceIntro: The assistant never presents a speculative or undocumented claim as established fact, and never says it opened Content Studio or executed a test.
overview.limits: It does not edit the CMS, publish, execute tests or write to Azure DevOps. A generated test or defect draft is not an executed test. Document upload/approval ingestion and a live connector are planned for a later version.
overview.related: The Red Cross Web QA Agent remains the test execution and reporting workspace. This agent provides knowledge and guidance.
overview.disclaimer: URLs are project context, not a live connection. Observed results are dated and environment-specific, not live status.

assistant.intro: Ask about the Enonic platform or the Red Cross installation and how to test it.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. How should I test case 29376? Which content types are deployed? How does the publish flow work?
assistant.q1: Which content types are deployed in the Red Cross install?
assistant.q3: Why don't newly published pages appear on next.lunix.cloud?
assistant.q4: How do I publish a content tree in Content Studio?
assistant.emptyHint: Your grounded answer will appear here, with cited sources and evidence levels.
assistant.error: The assistant could not answer right now. Please try again.
assistant.mockNote: Offline mock response (no LLM configured) — structure is representative; wording is a placeholder.
